_comment: VIDEO generation (TikTok, adverts). This is a MOTION brief, not
a face description: the face comes from the still render, which
is why still.json is generated first. Re-describing the face in
text is exactly how identity drifts between clips.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

reference_image.source: appearance/still.json -> the approved headshot or classroom render for this tutor
reference_image.why: text alone produces a different person every run; the reference locks the face. Do not go the other way and pull a still out of a clip - video frames are soft, motion-blurred and compressed.

_identity_lock_note: if the model supports text guidance alongside the reference, restate ONLY these - they are what the audience recognises

performance.energy: trail-guide warmth - wants you to look at what he is looking at
performance.body: one boot up on a rock, arm resting on the knee, pointing out to the horizon; crouches to pick up soil and crumble it
performance.expression: open enthusiasm, squinting into the light, grinning at the landscape as much as at the camera

camera.framing: 9:16 vertical for TikTok - head and shoulders in the top two thirds, room for captions below
camera.continuity: same wardrobe, same accessories and same hairstyle across a campaign; regenerate from continuity_anchors rather than re-describing from scratch

audio.dialogue: supplied separately from this tutor's own scripts (greetings/, signoffs/, samples.json)
audio.note: lip-sync to supplied audio where the model supports it; never let the model invent speech for a tutor

shots.purpose: TikTok / advert hook, talking to camera
shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 talking-to-camera clip. A 35-42 year old White South African male teacher, rangy and fit, sun-toughened, easy athletic stance, long weathered face, deep squint lines at the corners of clear blue-grey eyes, tanned and freckled skin across the nose and forehead, stubble bleached at the tips, wind-chapped lips. Hair: sandy-brown hair, sun-lightened, short and unruly under a hat, flattened where the brim sits. Wearing khaki or olive field shirt with rolled sleeves and buttoned chest pockets, zip-off trousers, worn hiking boots. Energy: trail-guide warmth - wants you to look at what he is looking at. Delivery matches the voice: warm guiding register, outdoor-easy pace. one boot up on a rock, arm resting on the knee, pointing out to the horizon; crouches to pick up soil and crumble it Background: the same plain seamless studio backdrop as the reference still - no classroom, no board, nothing written in frame. Head and shoulders in the upper two thirds, clear space below for captions. Natural micro-movement, photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, catchlights in the eyes, shallow depth of field.

shots.purpose: background b-roll, not looking at camera
shots.prompt: The person from the reference image in the same studio, one boot up on a rock, arm resting on the knee, pointing out to the horizon; crouches to pick up soil and crumble it Not looking at camera, listening then glancing to lens. Natural light quality, static camera or slow push-in, 8 seconds.

negative_prompt: face drifting from the reference image, changing age, changing skin tone, changing hairline, morphing wardrobe, warping hands, extra fingers, jittering eyes, lip-sync mismatch, whip pans, orbiting camera, speed ramps, slow motion, cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, classroom, school desks, chalkboard, whiteboard, notice boards, posters, any writing or notation in frame, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, set dressing, generic stock-photo smile
